Kinetic ends on a cut with no hold: "The last line lands on the track's loudest bar, then a hard cut to the ground on the bar. No static restatement. The drop on the reveal wins over this: when no loudest bar falls after the reveal in the film's window, the last line lands on the next strong bar after the reveal (a bar of `beats().bars`, or a cut point of `beats().cuts`), and the cut to the ground comes on the bar after it."
